{{Top|leg}}
'''Mekto''' was the name given by the [[Tahlboorean]]s to the huge, carnivorous arachnid creatures that lived in caves on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tahlboor]]. The creatures actively hunted warm-[[Blood/Legends|blooded]] organisms.
